description_en: Queries the log delivery status for protected objects
description_zh: 查询防护对象日志外发投递状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-log-delivery-status --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-g6z3z00000 --resources alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-00000,test.waf.com-waf --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protected objects that you want to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
